landing.source: nasa-mer-spirit (date); MER landing sol = Sol 1 (Mars24 notes)
landing.solNote: catalogue gives the landing DATE as 3 January (US); the UTC time used for the sol count is ILLUSTRATIVE

scene.label: Columbia Memorial Station, early mission: Spirit beside its lander after rolling off (date and offset ILLUSTRATIVE)
scene.tauLabel: tau 0.5 ASSUMED (no sourced optical depth for this sol in the scene)

hardware.label: Spirit rover
hardware.provenance: NASA MODEL (NASA 3D Resources articulated MER model; Spirit and Opportunity were twins), solar-panel span scaled to 2.25 m (PDS). Position beside the lander ILLUSTRATIVE.

hardware.label: MER-A lander (Columbia Memorial Station)
hardware.provenance: SIMPLIFIED MODEL — no NASA model of the MER lander exists. Base, three opened petals, deflated airbags and egress aids; shapes and dimensions ILLUSTRATIVE. Placed at the sourced landing coordinate.

origin.source: PDS ODE (Arvidson et al. 2004), landing site
origin.registration: Catalogue coordinate; the hardware has NOT been identified in the HiRISE orthoimage yet. Historical coordinate frames can differ from the HiRISE/MOLA-controlled frame by up to hundreds of metres, so the true spot may be elsewhere in this terrain or beyond it.

terrain.dtm: USGS Astrogeology controlled HiRISE DTM DTEEC_001513_1655_001777_1650_U01 (collection mro_hirise_socet_dtms)
terrain.albedo: HiRISE orthoimage (RED band, single channel) at 0.5 m, colourised with an ILLUSTRATIVE soil ramp
terrain.horizon: same DTM, decimated to ~24 m, out to ~9 km where the DTM covers it
